repairs.old: Main idea: rösten means to roast or roast food, especially coffee, bread, seeds or nuts.
repairs.finalEn: Main idea: rösten means to roast or toast food, especially coffee, bread, seeds, or nuts.

repairs.old: Main idea: rüsten means to prepare or equip. In a military context, it means to arm or arm.
repairs.finalEn: In a military context, it means to arm or equip with weapons.

repairs.old: If preparation involves equipment, der rüsten.
repairs.finalEn: If preparation involves equipment, use rüsten.

repairs.old: To prepare, to equip • To arm
repairs.finalEn: To prepare, to equip oneself • To arm

repairs.old: Main idea: die Schicht means layer or layer. In a work context, it means change.
repairs.finalEn: In a work context, it means shift.

repairs.old: The surface has Schicht; work can have Schicht as a shift.
repairs.finalEn: A surface can have a Schicht, or layer; at work, Schicht can mean a shift.

repairs.old: Main idea: schmelzen means to melt or fuse. If the substance changes itself, it is translated as 'move' • If someone does it, it translates as 'melting'.
repairs.finalEn: schmelzen means to melt. If the substance changes by itself, translate it as “to melt”; if someone melts something, use “to melt” with an object.
To melt or to melt something

repairs.old: Main idea: schmieren means to smear, smear, or smear a surface. Colloquially, it can also mean to write sloppily or to scribble.
repairs.finalEn: spread, smear, or coat a surface

repairs.old: The child clawed at the wall.
repairs.finalEn: The child scribbles on the wall.

repairs.old: To smear, to smear, to smear
repairs.finalEn: To spread, to smear, to scribble messily

repairs.old: To bloom, to paint with the movement of a brush
repairs.finalEn: To spread or paint with a brush

repairs.old: Must be protected from the sun.
repairs.finalEn: You must protect yourself from the sun.

repairs.old: Main Idea: Senden means to send a message or send a signal/broadcast. In everyday life, it is often more natural for people to have schicken.
repairs.finalEn: In everyday life, it is often more natural for people to use schicken.

repairs.old: Sinn für Humor is a sense of humor, not literally “sense of humor”.
Main idea: der Sitz means a seat or seat. For a company or institution, it means domicile.
repairs.finalEn: der Sitz means a seat or seating place. For a company or institution, it means headquarters.

repairs.old: sowie is not automatically just “as soon as”; in lists it often means 'as well as'.
repairs.finalEn: sowie does not always mean “as soon as”; in lists, it often means “as well as.”

repairs.old: Main Idea: die Spannung means tension or tension. In technical language, especially in electricity, it means voltage.
repairs.finalEn: Main idea: die Spannung means tension or strain. In technical language, especially in electricity, it means voltage.

repairs.old: In electricity, die Spannung translates as tension, not emotional tension.
repairs.finalEn: In electricity, die Spannung translates as voltage, not emotional tension.

repairs.old: Tension in a story or relationship; in electricity voltage.
repairs.finalEn: Tension in a story or relationship; in electricity, voltage.

repairs.old: an der Spitze means under the leadership, not just physically above.
repairs.finalEn: an der Spitze means at the top or in charge, not just physically above.

repairs.old: In the technique der Stift can be a pin instead of a pencil.
repairs.finalEn: In technical contexts, der Stift can be a pin rather than a pencil.

repairs.old: Main idea: stillen most often means to breastfeed. With need, thirst, or curiosity, it means to appease or satisfy.
repairs.finalEn: With needs, thirst, or curiosity, it means to relieve or satisfy them.

repairs.old: Main idea: streichen means to strike or remove from a list. By wall, fence, or paint, it means to paint • With the hand - to caress.
repairs.finalEn: streichen means to cross out or remove something from a list. With a wall, fence, or paint, it means to paint; with a hand, it means to stroke.
Delete a file or text; put out a fire

repairs.old: eine Wand streichen means to paint the wall, not to streak the wall.
repairs.finalEn: eine Wand streichen means to paint the wall, not to cross out the wall.

repairs.old: Main idea: stürzen means to fall or topple rapidly. With an object, it can mean overthrow, also overthrow a government or an official.
repairs.finalEn: With an object, it can mean to knock something down; it can also mean to overthrow a government or official.

repairs.old: Main idea: die Szene means a scene in a film, theatre or a specific situation. Colloquially, it can also mean a certain environment of people.
repairs.finalEn: a particular social group or scene

repairs.old: In the movie, it's a scene; in a circle or style of people - Szene.
repairs.finalEn: In a film, it is a scene; for a social group or style, use Szene.

repairs.old: Main Idea: der Tau means dew—drops of water on grass or leaves. It is uncountable (singular only). Das Tau, on the other hand, means a ship's tow or rope.
repairs.finalEn: Das Tau, on the other hand, means a ship's towline or rope.

repairs.old: der Tau = dew (singular only). das Tau = tow (die Taue). The article completely changes the meaning.
repairs.finalEn: das Tau = towline or rope (die Taue).

repairs.old: In church or giving a formal name: taufen.
repairs.finalEn: In church or when giving something a formal name: taufen.

repairs.old: taufen is not to bet; it means to baptise or give a name.
repairs.finalEn: taufen does not mean “to bet”; it means to baptise or give a name.

repairs.old: I don't know the name of the song.
repairs.finalEn: I don't know the title of the song.

repairs.old: A book, song or film usually has a der Titel.
repairs.finalEn: A book, song or film usually has a title.

repairs.old: in einem Ton speaking means manner of speaking, not just pitch.
repairs.finalEn: “In einem Ton” when speaking refers to a manner of speaking, not just pitch.

repairs.old: Please speak in a calm tone.

repairs.finalEn: He does not dare to speak alone.

repairs.old: Trust someone: trauen; dare yourself: sich trauen.
repairs.finalEn: Trust someone: trauen; dare to do something: sich trauen.

repairs.old: He does a lot of sports.
repairs.finalEn: He does a lot of sport.

repairs.old: sich trennen means to separate; verskeiden means to distinguish by characteristics.
repairs.finalEn: sich trennen means to separate; unterscheiden means to distinguish by characteristics.

repairs.old: Bez sich tas ir nodot; ar sich tas ir vemt.
repairs.finalEn: Without sich, it means “to hand over”; with sich, it means “to vomit.”

repairs.old: Einen Motor überholen means overhauling, not overhauling the engine.
repairs.finalEn: Einen Motor überholen means overhauling an engine, not overtaking it.

repairs.old: Kosten oberkemen means to bear the cost, not just to receive it.
repairs.finalEn: Kosten übernehmen means to bear the costs, not just to receive them.
You must not circumvent the rules.

repairs.old: Main idea: unterhalten means to entertain or maintain. sich unterhalten means to talk.
repairs.finalEn: unterhalten means to entertain or support. sich unterhalten means to talk.

repairs.old: Bez sich: to entertain or maintain; with sich: to talk.
repairs.finalEn: Without sich: to entertain or support; with sich: to talk.

repairs.old: Main idea: die Untersuchung means investigation, examination or study. The context determines whether it is a doctor, a police officer, or a scientist.
repairs.finalEn: The context determines whether it refers to a medical examination, a police investigation, or a scientific study.

repairs.old: The doctor examines, the police investigate, science investigates: die Untersuchung.
repairs.finalEn: The doctor examines, the police investigate, and scientists conduct studies: die Untersuchung.

repairs.old: Main idea: To change means to change something so that it becomes different. sich veränderen means to change yourself.
repairs.finalEn: sich verändern means to change or to change oneself.

repairs.old: If something becomes different, veränderen is often used.
repairs.finalEn: If something becomes different, verändern is often used.

repairs.old: sich veränderen is to change oneself; veränder bez sich means to change something else.
repairs.finalEn: sich verändern means to change oneself; verändern without sich means to change something else.

repairs.old: der Verband not die Verbindung: A bandage or association is not a connection.
repairs.finalEn: der Verband is not die Verbindung: a bandage or association is not a connection.

repairs.old: Has a direct connection to Berlin.
repairs.finalEn: There is a direct connection to Berlin.

repairs.old: die Verbindung is not der Verband. Bandage and bandage are different words.
repairs.finalEn: die Verbindung is not der Verband. A connection and a bandage are different words.

repairs.old: Main idea: verbrennen means to burn or burn to the point of destruction. With a body part, it means to burn.
repairs.finalEn: Main idea: verbrennen means to burn something or burn up completely. With a body part, it means to burn yourself.

repairs.old: To burn, to burn, to burn
repairs.finalEn: To burn, burn up, burn yourself

repairs.old: sich die Hand verbrennen means to burn the hand, not to burn the hand to the end.
repairs.finalEn: sich die Hand verbrennen means to burn your hand, not to burn it completely.

repairs.old: Main idea: verderben means to spoil something or spoil yourself. For food, it often means that it is no longer edible.
repairs.finalEn: Main idea: verderben means to spoil something or become spoiled. For food, it often means that it is no longer edible.

repairs.old: Food, plan or mood can verderben.
repairs.finalEn: Food, a plan, or a mood can spoil.

repairs.old: verdorben for food means spoiled, not just bad tasting.
repairs.finalEn: verdorben for food means spoiled, not simply tasting bad.

repairs.old: Main idea: der Wechsel means change or change. In special phrases such as Exchange rate, the meaning becomes specific.
repairs.finalEn: der Wechsel means a change or switch. In compounds such as Wechselkurs, the meaning becomes more specific.

repairs.old: der Exchange rate means the exchange rate, not simply the exchange process.
repairs.finalEn: der Wechselkurs means the exchange rate, not simply the process of changing or exchanging.

repairs.old: Main idea: Zubegen means to admit a mistake or a truth. With food or substances, dazubegen means to add to.
repairs.finalEn: zugeben means to admit a mistake or the truth. ... dazugeben means to add something.

repairs.old: Gib Salz dazu is to be added to, not acknowledged.
repairs.finalEn: Gib Salz dazu means “add salt,” not “admit.”

repairs.old: Main idea: zünden means to ignite, to set in motion, or to work. Anzünden is often used for specific kindling.
repairs.finalEn: Main idea: zünden means to ignite, to set in motion, or to work. Anzünden is often used when lighting something specific.

repairs.old: Main idea: zünden means to ignite, to set in motion, or to work. Anzünden is often used for specific kindling.
A mechanism, fire, or idea starts working: zünden.
Main idea: die Steuer means tax. The plural is die Steuern. Das Steuer, on the other hand, means a rudder or a steering wheel - the steering device of a ship or car.
repairs.finalEn: das Steuer means a rudder or steering wheel
